confirmed_wrapper_invariants.finding: Provider validation requires integer ABI version 4 and the v4 provider identity. The approved human policy is a required source-closure input with its exact digest; request validation binds its one-row-per-existing-query, five-second bound, no-extra-query/retry, tracked-PID fail-closed rule, automatic-retry false, and publication hold. The derived authority must bind the same policy reference.

Only the existing historical-absence/no-fresh-contender status and the new interval status enter the accepted-status branch. New-status continuation requires one typed positive PID, not an original candidate or pre-existing tracked PID, absent from tracked_after, complete evaluation, no fresh contenders, unknown ownership/foreignness, no continuous/OS-global absence claim, and cleanup false. Continuation is recorded only after a durable reconciliation receipt and every query/evaluation/receipt deadline check is within the original deadline.

After durable receipt and deadline checks, the interval PID is added to historical_absent_pids. Later command or native raw snapshots detect the PID by number and fail closed before descendant tracking. validate_interval_evaluation requires the PID absent from tracked_after, and the evaluator's tracked_after remains the only map assigned to tracked; the added PID is not inserted into ownership or cleanup state by this wrapper.

LOCK remains the existing /private/tmp/dataflowbench-v0.9.0-exclusive-analyzer.lock path. Bootstrap observes that existing file read-only and obtains its exclusive nonblocking flock; the parent validates and inherits the same file descriptor/inode. No helper creates or replaces a lock. Resource code retains 127 GiB launch, 125 GiB active, 110 GiB outer floors, 30 GiB aggregate working cap, 12 GiB per-source cap, 24 GiB scratch/retention ceilings, and the 4 GiB namespace capture cap. The 40 GiB field is a protected reserve, not the launch floor. retained_resources.py derives live policy/authority values and covers ledger/unclosed task-root accounting without runtime replay.

archive_evidence.py pins its running helper to the 09 path; diff inspection found this is its only production source change from 08. retained_resources.py is byte-identical to 08. test_source_boundary.py asserts the qualifier function/class changes and the helper-path-only/resource invariants; no tests were run in this review.

cross_review_condition.finding: validate_interval_evaluation checks that the historical-only collection is a one-element list and that its row has a positive integer PID, but does not validate the row's own status, per-row unknown labels, or exact source/origin/witness/identity/absence fields. The wrapper also does not independently count first-only records in the raw query or re-check their same/other/command snapshot absences. It therefore relies on the exact source-bound reconciliation evaluator to produce a canonical row and reject every ineligible/multiple/present row. The in-scope interval test rejects malformed counts/PIDs and top-level uncertainty flags but does not exercise a mislabeled row or a missing absence witness.
cross_review_condition.required_resolution: Before freezing the full source set, the pending independent reconciliation review must prove the evaluator enforces the approved per-row schema, exactly-one total event per existing query, no-drop behavior, all absence predicates, candidate/tracked exclusion and error fail-closed behavior, with focused tests. If that contract cannot be established, add explicit row-shape checks at this wrapper boundary and update the in-scope tests.
cross_review_condition.review_scope_limit: The provider and process_reconciliation worker files were not inspected here, per the assigned scope; no claim is made that their checks are complete.

scope.statement: Static review limited to native_qualifier.py, archive_evidence.py, retained_resources.py, test_interval_supervision.py and test_source_boundary.py for native-controls-09. This is not full provider/reconciliation approval, a test result, source freeze, invocation approval or launch authorization.
